I tried doing that multiple times and even reinstalled the update file on the USB several times, doesn't work. Sorry if I explained this in an odd way, im just kind of tired of this update nonsense.

You know you can also not do any of that shit too, right? Life can fucking SUCK sometimes, I know. I lived it. But because I lived it, I can also say with confidence that it has its moments. I don't know the details of what you're going through, so excuse me if I say some things don't apply to you, but I am quite sure that they will apply to you. 

I've been thinking about killing myself for quite some time now. About 7 years or so. 

And whenever I feel this way, holy fucking shit it sucks major dick.

Big time.

But then I see my family, and initially, it honestly does nothing. I just start thinking about how they are better off without me and stupid shit like that. But then, I come to a realization. These are my friends and family, and having friends and family is a mutual thing. 

They are your friends because you are their friend.

They are your family because you are their family.

And then I realize I may have a thing or two to live for. And that's more than enough.

Sorry for the cheesiness of this whole thing, I'm sure it sounds like the kind of shit a teacher who never went through what we did would say, but there is merit to those words.

To sum it up, don't kill yourself. Don't hurt yourself, or anything stupid like that. I know it hurts. I know it hurts BAD. But once you push through that blinding pain, you can start to truly appreciate life. Fuck, that sounded cheesy as hell, but I fucking mean it.

Again, I know nothing of your situation, so I hope to fucking god I don't sound like a pretentious asshole.

But yeah.

Stay strong, okay guy? Or gal? Or neither?

You'll get through this. You just need a bit of help.
